purpose: Re-run the existing finite diagnostic without mutating the historical R-200 package. The current R-193 manifest is pinned explicitly so a stale historical hash cannot be mistaken for a mathematical failure.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing current-authority revalidation only.
